feeds.title: Canadian Federation of Nurses Unions
feeds.description: The Canadian Federation of Nurses Unions (CFNU) is the voice of nearly 200,000 unionized nurses and nursing students across the country. We are proud to advocate for our members and promote the nursing profession on the national level, and we work tirelessly to protect the quality of health care for our patients and our universal public health care system.

feeds.title: Nursing Informatics Learning Center Blog
feeds.description: This website was first created in 2000 by June Kaminski as a medium for sharing nursing informatics information and to encourage nurses to learn more about this evolving field. It is the author's firm belief that all nurses around the planet need informatics knowledge and skills.

feeds.title: BC Nursing History Blog
feeds.description: In 1989 interested registered nurses banded together and formed the B.C. History of Nursing Professional Practice Group under the umbrella of the Registered Nurses Association of BC. Our mission is to discover, disseminate, and preserve BC's nursing history.

feeds.title: NNPBC Blog
feeds.description: NNPBC is the professional body representing all nursing professions in British Columbia. We support and promote excellence in nursing practice, education, research, leadership and policy by advocating for healthy public policy, promoting excellence in nursing practice and empowering nurses to actively influence and shape decisions that affect the profession and the public they serve.

feeds.title: Canadian Nurses Foundation
feeds.description: Since 1962, the Canadian Nurses Foundation has helped nurses learn, investigate and advance nursing best practices. We improve the delivery of health care by awarding scholarships to promising nursing students and nurses at all educational levels, and by funding nurse-led research that enhances the quality and efficacy of patient care.

feeds.title: Nurse Practitioner Association of Alberta Blog
feeds.description: The Nurse Practitioner Association of Alberta represents Alberta Nurse Practitioners in Alberta. We advocate for broad integration of Nurse Practitioners in every area of healthcare in Alberta.

feeds.title: Priya Basil Blog
feeds.description: Priya Basil is a Business Women and a Proud Nursing ExamReview provider. She has instilled confidence and guided more than thousands of nursing students across Canada to overcome exam fear, negative attitude, memory problems, and other exam related issues.

feeds.title: NCLEX Education Blog
feeds.description: Find NCLEX test tips, updates, and videos on our NCLEX Blog: strategies to pass the NCLEX-RN exam, testing changes related to COVID-19 and more. Our team is passionate about nursing education and facilitating nursing students from around the globe in successfully passing the NCLEX-RN examination.

feeds.title: Neighborhood Nursing Blog
feeds.description: Get the best senior home care for your loved ones in the Kootenays area. Neighborhood Nursing is locally owned by a Registered Nurse, bondable, insured fully licensed staff, that are dependable, and available when needed, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

feeds.title: College of Licensed Practical Nurses of Alberta Blog
feeds.description: The College of Licensed Practical Nurses of Alberta (CLPNA) regulates the licensed practical nurse profession in a manner that protects and serves the public.

feeds.title: Select Medical Connections Blog
feeds.description: Travel Talk by Select Medical Connections is a travel nurse blog written by travel nurses. Learn what travel nursing in Canada is all about!

feeds.title: Nurse Avenue Blog
feeds.description: Nurse Avenue is a networking community and job centre for Canadian nurses. We are dedicated to creating a tailored site suited to finding quality jobs with reputable employers.
